pledges_vs_reality.pledge: Paris Agreement / global net-zero: emissions must fall now
pledges_vs_reality.reality: Energy-related CO2 rose ~145 Mt in 2025 to a record ~38.4 Gt; fossil+cement CO2 up 1.1% to record 38.1 Gt

pledges_vs_reality.pledge: New 2035 NDCs marketed as raised, 1.5C-aligned ambition
pledges_vs_reality.reality: UNFCCC: only ~12% GHG cut by 2035 vs 2019; ~60% needed. UNEP EGR 2025: 2.3-2.5C with NDCs, 2.8C current policies
96% (3,455) of analysed companies show >=1 greenwashing red flag; self-declared leaders cut only ~36-40% of actual footprint

pledges_vs_reality.pledge: 'Carbon neutral flying' and offset-based product labels
pledges_vs_reality.reality: 21 airlines committed 5 Nov 2025 to change claims after EU/CPC action; ECGT bans offset-based 'climate neutral' claims from Sept 2026
pledges_vs_reality.gap: Regulators now treating these claims as misleading

highlights: Record global CO2: ~38.4 Gt in 2025 (IEA Global Energy Review 2026)
New NDCs deliver only ~12% cut by 2035 vs 2019, far from the ~60% needed
96% of analysed corporate net-zero claims carry at least one greenwashing red flag
EU bans offset-based 'climate neutral' product claims from September 2026
actions_taken: Researched UNFCCC, UNEP, IEA, Global Carbon Project, Carbon Market Watch/NewClimate, EU Commission green claims
Committed, pushed, opened PR for human review (NOT merged)
